doctrines.title: Constitutional Fidelity
doctrines.description: All authority must derive directly from the Constitution or valid federal statute. Any deviation is void.

doctrines.title: Void Ab Initio
doctrines.description: Any action taken without lawful authority is void from the beginning and carries no legal force.

doctrines.title: Non-Delegation Doctrine
doctrines.description: Authority cannot be expanded beyond what Congress explicitly delegated.

doctrines.title: Federal Preemption
doctrines.description: Federal law overrides conflicting state law and administrative practices.

doctrines.title: Commerce Limitation
doctrines.description: Commerce authority applies only to trade, traffic, or transportation of persons or property for compensation.

doctrines.title: Due Process
doctrines.description: Government actions must follow lawful procedure and cannot arbitrarily deprive rights.
